data.one_liner: Flutter SDK for passkey authentication via Corbado
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs to sign up, log in, and manage sessions using passkeys on Android, iOS, and Web. Includes fallback email OTP and diagnostics.
use_when: You need passkey-based authentication without building your own backend
You want a single SDK that handles session management and token refresh
You target Android, iOS, or Web platforms
avoid_when: You only need simple email/password auth
You require a different authentication provider like Firebase Auth
strengths: Built-in session management and token refresh
Diagnostic tool (Corbado Doctor) for setup validation
weaknesses: Requires Corbado backend, not a generic auth provider
No support for Linux, macOS, Windows
data.setup_notes: Add package to pubspec, run flutter pub get, initialize CorbadoAuth with projectId and optional debugMode. No build_runner needed.
data.minimal_example:
final corbadoAuth = CorbadoAuth();
await corbadoAuth.init(projectId: "YOUR_PROJECT_ID", debugMode: true);
